long_biography.plain_text:
Rijsterborgh entered Amsterdam real estate as a residential broker before moving into construction supervision and establishing his own commercial brokerage in 1970. He expanded it into a property group that combined brokerage with development, direct investment and management, building a portfolio of housing, offices and business premises across the Netherlands.

As a private investor, he became known for buying and selling large institutional portfolios. He acquired the former Rijks Post Spaarbank estate, purchased Zwitserleven's complete property package in 1995 and sold his Westelijk Halfrond development and investment company to a listed fund. The family business remained based in Amstelveen, where its residential tower became his final major development and his son Edwin continued the enterprise.
long_biography.html:
Rijsterborgh entered Amsterdam real estate as a residential broker before moving into construction supervision and establishing his own commercial brokerage in 1970. He expanded it into a property group that combined brokerage with development, direct investment and management, building a portfolio of housing, offices and business premises across the Netherlands.

As a private investor, he became known for buying and selling large institutional portfolios. He acquired the former Rijks Post Spaarbank estate, purchased Zwitserleven's complete property package in 1995 and sold his Westelijk Halfrond development and investment company to a listed fund. The family business remained based in Amstelveen, where its residential tower became his final major development and his son Edwin continued the enterprise.
